title: Predator: Killer of Killers
notes: Animated. Released on Hulu (US) and Disney+ (international).

in_universe.label: 841–1942 (anthology)
in_universe.note: In Karelia in the year 841, Viking warrior Ursa leads her son Anders and their clan on an expedition to destroy the Krivich tribe and their leader, Zoran, who forced Ursa to kill her own father, Einar, the previous Earl of Ladoga, when she was a child. Anthology: segments in 841 (Viking), 1609 ("In 1609 in Japan, brothers Kenji and Kiyoshi…") and 1942 ("In 1942, John J. Torres is drafted…"), then a finale on the Yautja homeworld. Placed first by its earliest segment; the finale is after 1942, so it overlaps Prey (1719).
It is the fifth installment in the Predator franchise and a prequel to Predator (1987), set in the Northern Great Plains in 1719.

release.note: Wikipedia: July 21, 2022 (San Diego Comic-Con); August 5, 2022 (United States)

in_universe.note: Isabelle identifies the captive Predator as matching the description of a creature that killed a special operations team in Guatemala before being defeated by a lone survivor in 1987. title: Predator: Badlands
notes: US release; TCL Chinese Theatre premiere 2025-11-03.

in_universe.label: far future, after all Alien films
in_universe.note: In October 2025, Trachtenberg stated in an interview with IGN that Predator: Badlands is set in the far future after the events of all the previous Alien and Alien vs. Predator films and the Alien: Earth TV-series so as to avoid any potential continuity conflicts, considering Romulus and Earth were still in production when Badlands was being produced. No year; relative placement is a director statement (implicitly after Alien Resurrection, 2381). Last in this continuity.
